name: Claude Code
description: Installs Anthropic's Claude Code CLI (https://code.claude.com/docs) as its native, sha256-verified release binary at /usr/local/bin/claude - no Node.js required - and disables the in-app auto-updater so the pinned version is what runs. Persist login and sessions across rebuilds by pointing CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR at a mounted folder (see the notes).

version.description: Claude Code version to install (e.g. '2.1.286'), or a release channel: 'stable' or 'latest'.
